## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.6
**New** - **Power controls** — the menu's Sleep row is now Sleep / Shutdown / Restart. Shutdown and Restart confirm first and reopen your apps and windows afterward. - **Tidier menu** — the menu-bar items are grouped by category (Displays, Audio, Windows, Network, Finder, Pointer/Scroll/Keys) so it's easier to scan.
**Improvements** - **Key & Button Remapping** — clearer in-dialog help for each rule type, and you can now record system shortcuts (like Control-`) directly in a rule. - **Window focus** — "Focus All Quadrants" reliably brings every quadrant window forward in a single press, even when another window is covering the screen.
